_: The homepage's room dioramas, shared by the site (beats.js) and the bake (blender/tools/bake_site.py --rooms). rect = [x0, z0, x1, z1] in the floor's plan units (1 = 8 ft); every diorama is cut to it and to `top` (wall height kept, units), baked on its own with the same open-top light, and framed by the site with az/el (degrees). Keep them close in size so every space reads the same.
